offering_description.value: WillScot supplies businesses with modular buildings, portable and temperature-controlled storage, temporary structures, and perimeter fencing. It configures buildings and storage units from its fleet and delivers them to customer sites.

We focus on doing one thing very well: making it easy for you to get the storage containers and modular buildings you need, configured as you need them, delivered where and when you need them.
